scope: Official Estonian source discovery for EU/EEA/Swiss free movement and third-country family members, residence, forms, visas and missions, administrative procedure, evidence, access to information, remedies, privacy, oversight, legal aid, and administrative courts. Switzerland is separately in scope where the Estonian law extends to Swiss nationals.
retrieval_status: 38 candidate source texts converted; exact English editions remain distinct from current Estonian texts; no source accepted
previous_findings_carried_forward: Denmark's EU-residence regulation was the seed; its existence is a comparison lead, not evidence of Estonian legal equivalence.
Swedish and Finnish source leads from the prior cross-state smoke remain provisional; no result from those countries was treated as current Estonian coverage.
The reviewed taxonomy's coverage gaps on procedure, file access, consular practice, remedies, privacy, oversight, and local operational guidance were carried into separate Estonia searches.
Czechia's unsuccessful API-registration path and stable official PDF fallback were carried forward as a reminder to verify publisher access and terms before adapter design.
N-Lex was used only as an EU-member-state legal-portal discovery route; official first-party Estonian pages were used for source verification where available.

search_coverage.coverage_limit: Riigi Teataja page rendering is JavaScript-only in the research client; some English records are stale or date-limited, and future-effective wordings appear beside currently operative text.

search_coverage.source_class: EU/EEA/Swiss residence guidance, forms and competent authorities
search_coverage.search_outcome: candidate(s) found; one material terminology conflict and forms-version gaps
search_coverage.coverage_limit: National ministry guidance describes rights as residence permits despite the statute's right-of-residence terminology; one local Tallinn page is not national coverage; PBGB guidance was not verified in this bounded search.
Mission representation and third-party visa-centre instructions are dynamic; portal pages are operational service surfaces, not legal content.
English and selected version records may lag; exact current law wording and form regulations require date-bound API queries.

search_coverage.source_class: Appeals, delay review, ombudsman and legal aid
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Visa appeal route is time-bound and changed in July 2025; State-funded Legal Aid Act record located ended 5 July 2025; no current replacement was resolved.

search_coverage.source_class: Privacy, personal data and public-information access
search_coverage.coverage_limit: DPA instructions require Estonian submissions for complaints/challenges; Riigi Teataja English Public Information Act result was versioned only through 31 August 2025 despite a current-alias URL.
Decision publication may be restricted or redacted; Supreme Court English summaries are selective; no bulk retrieval/conversion rule exists.
Oversight, access-to-information challenge and judicial appeal are separate routes and are not interchangeable.
